_comment: AI Video Generator 1.1 — AUTO MODE Preset Template
_instructions: This preset uses 'auto' mode: the script fetches trending news
headlines and GLM-4.7 writes video prompts from them automatically.
HOW TO USE:
1. Copy this file:  copy auto_example.json my_preset.json
2. Edit the values below to match your needs
3. Run:  python utils/video_gen.py --preset presets/my_preset.json
WHAT TO CHANGE:
• model     — video backend: kling, veo3, sora-kie, sora, sora-pro
kling=Kling 3.0 (kie.ai), veo3=Veo 3.1 Fast (kie.ai),
sora-kie=Sora 2 Pro (kie.ai), sora=Sora 2 (OpenAI),
sora-pro=Sora 2 Pro (OpenAI)
• region    — 2-letter country code (US, GB, JP, AU, etc.)
• language  — 2-letter language code (en, zh, ja, es, etc.)
• topic     — news category OR any keyword (e.g. 'AI chips')
Available: top, world, nation, business, technology,
entertainment, sports, science, health
• style     — visual style: cinematic, documentary, noir, anime, etc.
• mood      — tone: dynamic, serene, tense, epic, playful, etc.
• videos    — number of videos to generate (1-10)
• aspect    — aspect ratio: 16:9, 9:16 (vertical), 1:1 (square)
• duration  — clip length in seconds: 5 or 10
• mode      — quality: std (720p, cheaper) or pro (1080p)
• sound     — true = AI-generated audio, false = silent
• image_urls — list of image lists, one inner list per video.
Each inner list holds one or more reference images for that scene.
Use [] for text-to-video (no image). Examples:
One image for scene 1, none for scenes 2-3:
[["images/photo.png"], [], []]
Two images for scene 1, one URL for scene 2:
[["images/a.jpg", "images/b.jpg"], ["https://…/ref.jpg"], []]
TIP: Set 'research' to search the web for background info.
e.g. 'solar farm technology photovoltaic efficiency'
GLM will use the facts to make prompts more accurate.
Fields starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by the script.
Any field you omit will use its default value (shown below).
